title: Nvidia CEO's joke on parenting that created a heated debate over Asian parenting
content: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang's joke about strict Asian parenting sparked a wide public discussion.  His upbringing instilled humility and resilience, fostering a focus on continuous improvement.  Supporters highlight his success as proof of this parenting approach's effectiveness.  Critics argue this model can cause lasting emotional harm despite good intentions.  The debate continues regarding the long-term impact of such demanding parental styles.

title: Tendulkar gets 'best batter' tag, but Lee names this all-rounder as GOAT

title: Latest Arunachal map shows 3 places illegally held by China

In response, the People's Liberation Army of China has erected various structures and roadways in these disputed territories. Historical conflicts have marked this sensitive border, and this mapping initiative effectively bolsters India's stance regarding the ongoing territorial dispute.

title: Michael Dell’s son’s startup offers $695 alternative to costly home generators
content: Zach Dell's Base Power is installing home battery systems across America.  These systems offer backup power and reduce electricity bills for customers.  The company aims to replace expensive gas generators with its innovative technology.  Base Power is rapidly expanding its operations and customer base nationwide.  This startup is valued at thirteen billion dollars after significant funding.

title: Punch the baby monkey turns 1, makes friends and gets a new enclosure
content: Punch, the orphaned Japanese macaque, joyously celebrated his first birthday, receiving heartfelt greetings from around the world. Now a part of a vibrant troop, he enjoys playful interactions and grooming sessions with fellow macaques. Generous donations funded significant upgrades to his enclosure, including plush toys from IKEA, and millions in contributions are set to enhance all macaque habitats, particularly to tackle welfare issues during Japan's sweltering summers.

title: Budapest’s Danube reveals 2 German soldiers and DKW bike after 80 years
content: Unusually low water levels in Budapest’s Danube River have exposed Second World War remains hidden for around 80 years. Recovery teams found the bodies of two Wehrmacht soldiers, their well-preserved identity discs, a German military motorbike, anti-tank mines and other wartime objects near Batthyány Square. The finds could help identify the soldiers and reveal more about Budapest’s final wartime days.

title: In 1997, Steve Jobs told employees: Nike sells shoes, yet inspires millions
content: Steve Jobs saw Nike's marketing as a prime example for Apple. He believed Nike sold inspiration, not just shoes to customers. Jobs urged Apple to focus on its core values and mission. This philosophy led to Apple's iconic "Think Different" campaign. The campaign celebrated creativity and innovation, not technical specifications.

This multifaceted portfolio highlights his ambition and keen sense for success in business.

title: West Indies suffer major blow, miss direct qualification for 2027 World Cup

This will be the third straight World Cup for West Indies where they need to qualify, while Ireland also missed direct entry following their lost against Afghanistan. The tournament is scheduled to take place in South Africa, Zimbabwe, and Namibia.

title: Bulandshahr encounter: Rape-murder accused carrying Rs 50,000 reward killed

Two officers sustained injuries, while two others were protected by bulletproof vests.  The injured suspect was rushed to the hospital and later declared dead by doctors.  Authorities are continuing their search for the second suspect who managed to escape.

title: Marathon hit! Shubman Gill bats for over an hour at NCC nets

title: Captain of turbulence-hit Phuket-Delhi flight may have failed dope test

The Directorate General of Civil Aviation is conducting a detailed investigation, and the flight crew has been suspended from flying duties as per standard procedures.

The initiative aims to elevate India's capabilities in small satellite launches.

title: Raja Raghuvanshi’s brothers booked for serving liquor without licence in Indore

The family's dhaba on CAT Road was inspected during a routine police checking drive.  Manager Sachin Raghuvanshi and others face charges under the Madhya Pradesh Excise Act.  Dhaba operator Vipin Raghuvanshi was also booked for not submitting employee details to police.  Police investigations into licensing and directives violations at local establishments will continue.

Rafael Nadal shared a deeply emotional statement for the family, and during a game, Rodrigo De Paul paid homage to Jorge's crucial role in shaping Messi's illustrious career.

title: Why Britain's housing market is losing momentum as mortgage rates rise again
content: Britain's housing market saw momentum slow in July, with prices remaining flat. Higher mortgage rates and economic uncertainty are impacting buyer demand significantly. Northern Ireland and Scotland recorded the strongest annual price growth across the country. Southern regions experienced price declines, widening the north-south divide. The market faces a weaker second half of 2026 due to borrowing costs.

title: ‘Gen Z is a force that can’t be ignored’: Dharmendra Pradhan days after resignation

He noted that the eagerness of young people surpasses any governmental duties, a point he shared with Prime Minister Narendra Modi, who subsequently reached out to the youth. Pradhan maintained that prioritizing the nation's welfare is of utmost importance.

title: Basant Meghwal makes history with silver at World Athletics U20 Championships

This victory makes him the first Indian high jumper to achieve this honor at the championship. Additionally, Ashish Yadav's silver medal in javelin throw helped boost India's total medal count to two.

title: 4.3-magnitude earthquake jolts Nashik; tremors cause cracks in houses

Although some homes showed small cracks due to the tremors, inspections of nearby dams indicated they remained intact. Residents are encouraged to stay vigilant and refrain from spreading misinformation during this time.

title: Watch: De Paul scores stunner, reveals Messi’s No. 10 jersey in emotional tribute

This emotional tribute honored his close friend, who was absent from the match. Messi missed the game after the passing of his father, Jorge Messi, at sixty-eight. De Paul's gesture offered a powerful message of support to his grieving friend.

The driver of the Mercedes, identified as Subham Sharma, was detained at the scene. It has been reported that Sharma was coming back from a party, and a blood sample for testing was taken. Fortunately, the occupants of the WagonR only suffered minor injuries.

title: The Stateless Kings: How Chess preserves an ideal in a fractured world
content: Aarav Dengla traces the journeys of chess players caught between their game and the politics of their countries. From Viktor Korchnoi’s defection from the Soviet Union to Alireza Firouzja’s break with Iran and Ian Nepomniachtchi playing under the FIDE flag after opposing Russia’s war, he explores how FIDE has stood between players and geopolitical upheavals, providing a neutral ground for those who could no longer compete under their national flags. For these stateless kings, the banner did not erase identity - it protected their freedom to play.
